---
title: "wrapped fixture: a document-level fig-column page"
filters:
  - wrapped
fig-column: page
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
  docx: default
---

With `fig-column: page` in the document, Quarto makes each figure float
page-wide in HTML and PDF through LaTeX, a cell's float with its own
`fig-column: body` included. A wrapped float keeps its normal layout with a
warning there, and wraps in PDF through Typst and Word. A captioned image
with no id is not a float, so it wraps in every format.

## A cell

```{r}
#| label: fig-meta-page-cell
#| fig-cap: "A cell figure in a fig-column page document."
#| classes: wrap-right
#| out-width: !expr if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) "5in"
plot(1:10)
```

## A cell with fig-column body

```{r}
#| label: fig-meta-page-body
#| fig-cap: "A cell figure with its own fig-column body."
#| fig-column: body
#| classes: wrap-right
#| out-width: !expr if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) "5in"
plot(1:10)
```
